summary: MediaPipe 1.0.0 was installed only in the project virtual environment as an optional experiment dependency; package import works but the pose task model is not yet present.
evidence: Import smoke test completed and confirmed the Tasks API package
lessons: MediaPipe 1.0 exposes the Tasks API rather than the legacy solutions namespace, so pose tracking requires an explicit task model asset.
limitations: No pose landmark inference has run yet because the pose task model has not been downloaded and hashed.
The optional install upgraded the virtual environment's OpenCV provider and therefore requires regression testing.
next_actions: Download the official pose landmarker task model into an ignored experiment directory, record its hash, and rerun the affected lightweight tests.
